intro: 采用用户给出的谷歌方案中视觉重塑部分：45°阶梯彩虹阵列、15色色卡、办公与学习色标分类。延续上一版4A的暖白底、浅灰阴影、清晰英文与克制留白。使用D盘原始产品照片作为身份及规格参考，保留原图，不修改价格、库存、变体或后台文案。

decisions: 保留谷歌方案的彩虹瀑布和45°层叠思路；以3组×5本让数量可数，不把少于15本的摆拍当成完整15色清单。
主图不加15色/1500张等广告文字；这些信息放副图与A+。主图候选只有实际售卖的便签，不放额外支架、笔、盒子或抽取器。
把15 Unique Neon Colors修正为15 Assorted Colors；品牌精致感来自比例、秩序、纸张质感和留白，不靠荧光饱和度或密集徽章。
原品质介绍讨论可重复贴附和平整胶位，但属于产品介绍而非本SKU测试报告。本版不照搬any surface、绝对无残胶、不掉落及优于国际品牌等措辞。
这是4A 30315平贴款图文包；30315-Z抽取款只作为区别核验。没有执行价格$14.99、企业价、净利计算、合并父子体或评论汇总，亦不保证购物车或销量变化。
所有新图为基于实物参考的AI设计审稿。正式上架前核对当前批次的色序、纸厚、胶位、白底和数量，并按实际模块槽位准备尺寸。生成画面不是实拍或测试证据。

listing.title: 4A Sticky Notes, 3 x 3 Inches, 15 Assorted Colors, 15 Pads, 100 Sheets per Pad, 1500 Sheets Total, Unlined Self-Stick Notes for Work and Study
bullets: 15 colors for your way of organizing
An assorted mix of soft, bright and neutral shades gives each project, subject or category its own visual cue. Choose a color system that makes sense for your daily routine.
Square, unlined pages leave space for quick reminders, short lists and small sketches. Keep one idea on each note so it is easy to find and revisit.
Each pad contains 100 sheets. Keep different colors close at your desk, study area or household planning space, with enough pads to share across your routine.
These are conventional flat sticky note pads, not accordion-style pop-up refills. Apply to a suitable clean, dry, smooth surface and press the adhesive area firmly; test delicate finishes first.
Bring color to work and study
Separate meeting actions, organize project stages, group study topics or leave an everyday reminder. Use color to give your notes a simple, consistent structure.
listing.description: Color, with purpose. 4A 30315 brings together 15 assorted colors in a familiar 3 x 3 inch square format. Use a different shade for each project, subject or task category, then write a short reminder in your own words. Each standard flat pad contains 100 unlined sheets, for 1500 sheets across the 15-pad pack. These pads are not accordion-style pop-up refills. Apply notes to suitable clean, dry, smooth surfaces and test delicate finishes first. Pens, notebooks, boards and other scene accessories are not included. Color appearance may vary with lighting and display settings.
